# Sorted

> Sorted (also referred to as Sort3d, at https://sort3d.space) is an organic growth workspace for mobile app and game teams. Its initial focus is Google Play.

## Product
- [About Sorted](https://sort3d.space/about): Founder Ahmed Akour; founded September 2026 in Jordan. Early-access software.
- [Google Play ASO](https://sort3d.space/features/google-play-aso): Product context, listing drafts, review, and supported listing-text publishing.
- [Listing localization](https://sort3d.space/features/app-localization): Editable localized listing drafts based on source copy. Does not translate the app interface.
- [Promotional content planning](https://sort3d.space/features/promotional-content): Product calendars, event copy, and creative briefs. Events are submitted in Play Console, not directly through Sorted.
- [Google Play integration](https://sort3d.space/integrations/google-play): Capability and permission details. Some reporting requires additional setup.
- [Early access](https://sort3d.space/pricing): Public paid plans are not listed. Contact the founder to discuss access and pricing.

## Resources
- [Free listing checker](https://sort3d.space/tools/google-play-listing-checker): Browser-only length checker for app name (30), short description (80), and full description (4000). No account required; not an ASO score or policy approval.
- [Growth guides](https://sort3d.space/guides): Practical ASO, localization, and event-planning articles with references.
- [Contact](https://sort3d.space/contact): akour@sort3d.space.

## Important context
AI outputs require human review. Sorted does not guarantee rankings, installs, or AI search citations. It does not currently provide a verified keyword-volume database or continuous store-rank tracking. Sorted is independent software and not affiliated with Google. Preview product Daylight is fictional. Product workspaces and account data are private and are not part of this public resource.
